sections.label: Rising fire fatalities
sections.summary: Fire fatalities rose from three in 2023 to five in 2024, with at least eight fire deaths recorded by August 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Fire fatalities rose from three in 2023 to five in 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: And by August 2025, we had already recorded at least eight fire deaths.

sections.label: HDB BTO gate locks
sections.summary: In 2019, HDB moved new BTO projects to mild-steel gates with a single cylinder lock and interior thumb turn for easier emergency egress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In 2019, HDB transitioned new Build-To-Order (BTO) projects to mild-steel gates with a single cylinder lock with an interior thumb turn that allows for easier egress in an emergency.

sections.label: Optional wrought-iron gate option
sections.summary: The improvement is paid and optional, not essential, and HDB still offers and subsidises an old-fashioned wrought-iron gate with double cylinder lock.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Critically, this is a paid, optional improvement, and is not part of the "essential improvements" package.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: But more worryingly, I believe that HDB continues to offer and subsidise the option of installing an old-fashioned wrought-iron gate with a double cylinder lock as an alternative option.

sections.label: AMD and PMA fires
sections.summary: Active mobility device fires rose 21.8% in 2024 to 67 cases, while personal mobility aid fires spiked 120%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Active mobility device (AMD) fires rose 21.8% in 2024 to 67 cases while personal mobility aid (PMA) fires saw a dramatic 120% spike.

sections.label: Dry riser not working
sections.summary: When firefighters arrived, they found the dry riser was not in proper working condition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: When firefighters arrived, they discovered that the dry riser was not in proper working condition.

sections.label: Seven hospitalised after fire
sections.summary: Seven people were hospitalised, including a firefighter and a child.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Seven people were hospitalised, including a firefighter and a child.

sections.label: Fire infrastructure inspection and Town Council support
sections.summary: The speaker proposes rigorous inspection regimes for fire-fighting infrastructure with published compliance rates and mandatory remediation timelines, and clearer enforcement mandates and more resources for Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Fourthly, we should implement more rigorous inspection regimes for fire-fighting infrastructure – wet risers, dry risers, booster pumps – with published compliance rates and mandatory remediation timelines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: And finally, we should support our Town Councils with clearer enforcement mandates, and more monetary resources and support to maintain the safety standards and keep fire safety infrastructure in good working order.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I have discussed three areas where we can do better: barriers to egress, battery fires and widening gaps across generations of flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Safety should not depend on when your block was built, whether you can afford an upgrade or which estate you call home.

sections.label: Fire safety for every home
sections.summary: The speaker says the task is to ensure excellence reaches every home and to make fire safety non-negotiable, not estate-dependent or income-dependent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Our task now is to ensure that excellence reaches every home and that we continue the commitment, regardless of age or estate maturity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Let us make fire safety non-negotiable, not optional, not estate-dependent and not income-dependent.

sections.label: Low fire fatality numbers
sections.summary: The number of fatalities has remained low, fewer than six on average per year in the past five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: The number of fatalities has also remained low, fewer than six on average per year in the past five years.

sections.label: Top causes of residential fires
sections.summary: Over the past five years the top three causes of residential fires were unattended cooking fires, electrical origin fires and naked flames such as candles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, I would like to share that the top three causes of residential fires in Singapore have been unattended cooking fires, which account for about a third of cases, fires of electrical origin and those arising from naked flames, such as candles.

sections.label: Fire Code standalone fire compartment principle
sections.summary: The Fire Code stipulates requirements, and a key principle is that every unit is a standalone fire compartment to limit fire spread before SCDF's arrival.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: The Fire Code stipulates requirements, and in particular, I would like to highlight that a key principle is how every unit is a standalone fire compartment to limit fire spread prior to SCDF's arrival.

sections.label: Upgrading older HDB flats
sections.summary: Where feasible, older HDB flats are upgraded with the latest and practical fire safety measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: Where feasible, we upgrade older HDB flats with the latest and practical fire safety measures where we can.

sections.label: AMD fires injuries fatalities
sections.summary: AMDs caused under 5% of residential fires but over 10% of injuries and 25% of fatalities, with most involving non-certified or illegally modified devices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: Even though AMDs accounted for less than 5% of residential fires over the past five years, they accounted for more than 10% of fire-related injuries and 25% of fatalities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: Between 2022 and 2025, of all AMD-related residential fires, more than 70% involved devices that were either not certified or tested to the relevant standards or had been illegally modified.

sections.label: LTA AMD enforcement and outreach
sections.summary: LTA detected over 5,000 non-compliant AMD cases, MOT introduced a Bill and plans online sale amendments, and the Taskforce continues outreach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: In the last five years, LTA detected over 5,000 cases of non-compliant AMDs and took action against offenders including riders, owners and retailers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: To keep non-compliant AMDs away from our homes, the Ministry of Transport (MOT) earlier today, introduced the Land Transport and Related Matters Bill for the First Reading.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: MOT is also looking to strengthen regulations on the online sale of AMDs and targets to make the necessary legislative amendments later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: I believe this graduated scaling-up in terms of our measures against AMDs is adequate at this juncture.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: In this regard, the Active Mobility Fire Safety Taskforce, co-chaired by LTA and SCDF, will continue to outreach to AMD owners under the Be Device-Safe programme, especially on safe charging practices and the dangers of non-compliant AMDs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming)
sentences.text: SCDF continues to work with Government agencies, as well as Town Councils and various community partners, to strengthen public education and outreach on public fire safety and emergency preparedness.

sections.label: Sitting time change notice
sections.summary: Pursuant to Standing Order 2(3)(a), the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 12.00 pm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Pursuant to Standing Order 2(3)(a), I wish to inform hon Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 12.00 pm.
